//: 'nativeDebugging': true loads BOTH the managed and the native debug engines
into the session. Without it, a breakpoint in native/src/api.cpp never binds
and stepping into a P/Invoke just steps over it - which looks exactly like
the native code not being called at all.
This is the single most useful setting in the repo while writing interop.
With it on you can set a breakpoint in C# at the DllImport call site, step
in, and land in the C++ function with a real call stack across the boundary.
It works because CopyGoopNativeLibrary drops goop_native.pdb next to goop_native.dll in
the output directory. Delete the pdb and you get addresses instead of lines.
Cost: mixed-mode sessions start noticeably slower. That is the trade.
For the TEST projects this file does not apply - VSTest spawns its own host
process. See dotnet/goop.runsettings and the note in README.md.

Goop.Gallery (managed only).//: Faster startup for when you are not debugging across the boundary.
